correctness.rationale: The Euclidean fixed-length constraint is preserved after ellipse-to-disk affine normalization as u²+κ² v²=δ², κ=b/a. On the minor axis each shift traces an exact interval [s-sqrt(κ²s²+η),s+sqrt(κ²s²+η)], η=1-δ². Away from the central O(sqrtη) region, positive and negative traces require disjoint shift signs; interval log-width tends to Λ=log((1+κ)/(1-κ)), establishing liminf J/log≥1/Λ. A geometric progression with ratio expΛ covers both traces with asymptotic count log(1/η)/Λ, proving exact limit. The four-sign indexed shift family covers a normalized square of fixed radius with 2/log(1+κ/8) leading coefficient; checked its factorization (r-1/(1+κ))(r-1/(1-κ)) and sign conditions. A compact interior-translate argument covers the rest of the ellipse using O_κ(1) shifts; finite ε<a, and ε≥a fails via center or arbitrarily small minor-axis points. All bounds hold with κ fixed in (0,1); coefficient for entire ellipse N is NOT determined. Source finite random checks cannot prove uncountable coverage.
risks: κ=b/a fixed in (0,1); circular and degenerate endpoints excluded, constants not uniform there.
Finite randomized coverage checks corroborate only sampled points, not a proof of coverage.
